column1: # Reviewed stock Arch/CachyOS maintenance hooks (plan 007, review F1).
# A relevant hook is trusted without static helper interpretation only when it
# is /usr/share/libalpm/hooks/<basename>, its Exec equals the reviewed words,
# and the hook file plus every bound program are proven against the owning
# retained bytes equal to the owner's authenticated base reference artifact
# (reviewed DB digest + base keyring signer), incoming bytes only from that
# owner's authenticated artifact. Approved programs seed the runtime closure
# (interpreter, libraries, gconv/NSS selections), which is proven the same way.
#   elf:/path=pkg          canonical native program owned by pkg
#   script:/path=pkg@sha   helper owned by pkg whose bytes are a reviewed revision
#   path:name=pkg          /usr/bin/name owned by pkg (root commits run PATH=/usr/bin)
#   shell:/bin/sh          bash interpreter chain to bash's native /usr/bin/bash
#   data:sysusers          incoming sysusers.d data limited to account entries
# journal catalog and hwdb databases; sysusers creates declared system
# packaged default fontconfig snippets; texinfo-install updates the info dir.
# Not listed, so audited by the static model and refused when opaque:
# systemd-hook tmpfiles (L/L+ can create .wants links), daemon-reload-system/
# enqueue-marked/reload/restart (service restarts), sysctl and binfmt; module

column3: /bin/sh -c 'while read -r f; do if test -f "$f"; then install-info "$f" /usr/share/info/dir 2> /dev/null; fi; done'
